answer: Harbor sybil tax guards the haven. Each agent docking at the wharf pays 45 credits per epoch, logged in a public berth ledger under its key. The jetty gate turns away unpaid or duplicate berths, and each extra identity needs another berth and another 45. Forging 1,000 identities costs 45,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, a loss from epoch one. A rented berth names its payer, exposing the ring. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its reward.
